name: meal
description: Rezepte finden, Nährwerte berechnen und Gerichte an deine Ernährung anpassen, mit einer Ersatz-Wissensbasis, die aus deinen Entscheidungen lernt.
long_description:
**Meal MCP** macht aus Claude einen Küchenassistenten mit Gedächtnis: Rezepte finden, Nährwerte berechnen und Gerichte an deine Ernährung anpassen.

**Was du damit machen kannst**

- **Rezepte** aus TheMealDB suchen und lokal speichern, mit Fotos als Dateien
- **Nährwerte** mit USDA-Daten berechnen, auch ohne gespeichertes Rezept und mit deutschen Zutatennamen
- **Zutaten ersetzen**: Claude schlägt vor, du entscheidest; freigegebene Regeln werden wiederverwendet, abgelehnte Vorschläge kommen nicht wieder
- **Varianten** speichern, zum Beispiel vegan oder ohne Nüsse, mit angepassten Mengen und umgeschriebener Anleitung
- **Vergleichen**: Original und Variante nebeneinander, Zutat für Zutat
- **Korrigieren**: falsche USDA-Treffer sperren oder Werte vom Etikett eintragen
- **Portionen**: Nährwerte pro Portion und Mengen für eine andere Personenzahl
- **Sichern**: alles als Datei exportieren und wieder einlesen

**So probierst du es aus**

- „Suche Chicken Handi, speichere es und berechne die Nährwerte.“
- „Mach das Rezept vegan und speichere die Variante.“
- „Vergleiche die Nährwerte der Variante mit dem Original.“

**Du brauchst** einen eigenen, kostenlosen USDA-API-Key (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup). Claude Desktop fragt bei der Installation danach.

**Gut zu wissen:** Rezepte, Regeln und Varianten liegen in einer lokalen Datenbank auf deinem Rechner. Sie liegt außerhalb der Erweiterung und übersteht eine Neuinstallation. Suchanfragen gehen an TheMealDB und USDA, Tool-Ergebnisse wie jeder Chatinhalt an Claude. Nährwerte sind Schätzungen. Tags wie „nussfrei“ ersetzen nicht den Blick aufs Etikett, und bei Allergien ist das keine verlässliche Grundlage.

usda_api_key.title: USDA API key
usda_api_key.description: Dein eigener, kostenloser Key für USDA FoodData Central: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup

tools.name: adapt_recipes
tools.description:
Adapt saved recipes with the substitution rules. Nothing is stored: pass items of adapted_recipes
to save_adapted_recipes to keep them.

Substitute amounts follow quantity_ratio; pieces become grams via USDA portions (enrich_recipes
first), the rest is listed in unverified_quantities. Tell the user about hidden_ingredients (only in
a measure text or the instructions, not replaced). Above 5 recipes compact; compact=false forces detail.

tools.name: add_substitutions
tools.description:
Add ingredient substitutions to the knowledge base, or change the quantity rule of an existing pair
(listed in updated). Optional: quantity_ratio (grams of target per gram of source, default 1.0) and
quantity_note (e.g. "1 egg = 1 tbsp ground flaxseed + 3 tbsp water").

tools.name: approve_substitutions
tools.description:
Approve pending suggestions as rules: [{id} or {source_ingredient, target_ingredient}], optional
"feedback" in the user's words (also later, for an approved one).

tools.name: calculate_nutrition
tools.description:
Nutrition of free ingredients without a saved recipe: [{name, measure}], e.g.
[{"name": "Hähnchen", "measure": "500 g"}]. Same matching as recipes; English names match more
reliably. Check usda_match and fix it with set_ingredient_matches.

tools.name: compare_nutrition
tools.description:
Compare variants with their originals (variant IDs, or an original ID for all its variants):
nutrients, difference, coverage and the effect of each change.

If comparable is false, difference is null: do not present partial_difference as a result; notes
names the cause. Above 5 comparisons compact; compact=false forces detail.

tools.name: delete_recipes
tools.description: Delete several locally saved recipes or variants. Deleting an original also deletes its variants.

tools.name: delete_substitutions
tools.description: Delete substitutions: [{source_ingredient, target_ingredient}].

tools.name: download_recipe_images
tools.description:
Save recipe photos as JPEG files, e.g. for a recipe book. size: small (150 px), medium (350 px),
large (500 px) or original (about 700 px). Default folder: images in the data folder. Variants get
their original's photo.

tools.name: enrich_recipes
tools.description:
Load USDA nutrition data for saved recipes. If complete is false, call again with the same IDs.
refresh=true looks up all ingredients again (use with a few recipes).

tools.name: export_data
tools.description:
Save all data (recipes, variants, rules, decisions, matches) to a JSON file; default folder:
exports in the data folder. Existing files are not overwritten.

tools.name: find_substitutions
tools.description:
Substitution rules per source ingredient, optionally filtered by constraints. Without ingredients,
all rules in the knowledge base.

tools.name: get_nutrition
tools.description:
Estimated nutrition of saved recipes (enrich_recipes first; ingredients without data are not counted).

ingredient_breakdown gives the USDA food and grams_basis per ingredient; per_serving appears once
servings are known. Above 5 recipes compact (totals, coverage, uncovered); compact=false forces detail.

tools.name: get_recipes
tools.description:
Return saved recipes or variants with ingredients, instructions and, for variants, constraints and
changes. Above 5 recipes compact (no instructions, image or changes); compact=false forces detail.

tools.name: import_data
tools.description: Load a file from export_data. Only adds what is missing; a damaged file imports nothing.

tools.name: list_ingredient_matches
tools.description:
USDA matches of ingredients with source (auto or manual), rejected foods and notes; without
ingredients all of them.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description:
List all saved recipes and variants. Variants have parent_mealdb_id, constraints and change_count;
originals list their variant_ids. Empty fields are left out.

tools.name: list_substitution_suggestions
tools.description: List suggestions with their decisions and feedback; status: pending, approved or rejected.

tools.name: record_substitution_suggestions
tools.description:
Store candidates as pending suggestions: source_ingredient, target_ingredient, reason,
confidence, tags. Candidates that break the constraints or were rejected before are returned in
excluded_candidates.

tools.name: reject_ingredient_matches
tools.description:
Reject wrong USDA matches: [{ingredient, fdc_id (default: current), note}]. The next best match
is loaded (new_matches).

tools.name: reject_substitutions
tools.description:
Reject pending suggestions: [{id} or {source_ingredient, target_ingredient}] with "feedback",
the user's reason (also later, for a rejected one).

tools.name: rewrite_instructions
tools.description:
Prepare rewriting variant instructions: one request per variant with instructions, changes and
guidelines. Write the text yourself, then call save_rewritten_instructions. force=true redoes
rewritten ones.

tools.name: save_adapted_recipes
tools.description:
Save adapted recipes as variants ("52795-v1"); originals stay unchanged. Pass items of
adapted_recipes, optionally edited: source_mealdb_id and ingredients [{position, name, measure}]
are required. Saving the same variant twice returns the existing one.

tools.name: save_recipes
tools.description: Load and save several TheMealDB recipes, including ingredients.

tools.name: save_rewritten_instructions
tools.description:
Store rewritten variant instructions: [{mealdb_id, instructions}], marked as LLM text. warnings
list replaced ingredients still mentioned.

tools.name: scale_recipes
tools.description:
Show amounts for another number of servings: [{mealdb_id, servings}]. Needs known servings;
nothing is saved (save_adapted_recipes keeps it as a variant).

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search TheMealDB for several recipe queries in one tool call.

tools.name: search_usda_foods
tools.description:
Search USDA foods for several terms: fdc_id, description and nutrients per 100 g, to pick a
match for set_ingredient_matches.

tools.name: set_ingredient_matches
tools.description:
Pin nutrition data to ingredients, kept on refresh: {ingredient, fdc_id, note}, or label values
{ingredient, calories_per_100g, protein_per_100g, fat_per_100g, carbs_per_100g, note}.

tools.name: set_recipe_servings
tools.description:
Store how many servings recipes make: [{mealdb_id, servings}]; variants inherit it. Use what
the user or the instructions say, do not guess.

tools.name: suggest_substitutions
tools.description:
Start the suggestion workflow: returns active rules, pending suggestions and, where neither
exists, a suggestion_request. Generate candidates for it and store them with
record_substitution_suggestions. Constraints e.g. {"diet": "vegan", "excluded_ingredients": ["tofu"]}.

tools.name: update_recipe_variants
tools.description:
Edit saved variants (not originals): mealdb_id plus name, instructions, constraints or the
complete new ingredients list [{position, name, measure}].
